inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A battle stage in the land of the Bloodridge, desert guardians in the manner of ancient Egypt, on the flat top of a high windswept hill above a sea of white clouds. Ash brown, sepia and corroded bronze with ember light, under a bright cold morning sky. Ember light glows only in doorways, in the cracks of the obelisks and in braziers, never on the ground. Only the few things named for this place stand here, along the far edge of the hill top; nothing else is built anywhere in the picture. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. No people anywhere, the fighters are added later. This place: the obelisk walk, the road to the temple.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a bright readable battle stage in a real lived in desert temple land on a hill above the clouds, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth and scale, readable silhouettes, the open ground calm and even so fighters read on it", "lighting": "Clear cold morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a6ab8", "#bfe0f4", "#ffffff", "#6a88b0", "#ece4ee", "#a898b8", "#7c7480", "#5a443a", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828", "#8c201c", "#d4c4a4", "#b0a084"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade fighting game stage, no people. The top third is sky over a sea of clouds, and the landmarks stand along the far edge of the hill top with their feet on one line a third of the way down. Everything below that line is one wide open flat ground where two armies will fight, calm and empty from the left edge to the right edge, with nothing standing on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 221, 1000], "desc": "a clear cold morning sky, deep blue above fading to pale blue at the horizon"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [156, 0, 325, 1000], "desc": "a sea of white clouds far below the hill with tall blue mountain peaks poking through it far away"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [78, 341, 377, 661], "desc": "one stepped pyramid of solid dark stone standing on the far end of the hill top behind the obelisks, a little hazy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [52, 21, 377, 305], "desc": "a row of tall dark stone obelisks with thin glowing ember cracks receding into the distance, bronze braziers between them"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [52, 697, 377, 981], "desc": "a second row of tall dark stone obelisks with thin glowing ember cracks receding into the distance, bronze braziers between them"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [373, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "flat bare warm tan stone of the hill top, the same stone as the camp's plateau, wind scoured and cracked into big plates with a few long thin dark cracks, crisp and clear, calm and even, no dust and no fog"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [846, 0, 1000, 123], "desc": "a toppled dark obelisk in the near foreground, in shadow"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [846, 886, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a dark broken stone edge in the near foreground, in shadow"}]}}
